caption: The drawing depicts a wooden armchair with a woven seat. The chair has four legs, each cylindrical and featuring rounded shapes along their length, known as turned wood detailing. The legs are connected near the bottom by horizontal stretchers, also with rounded, turned appearances on the front and sides. The back of the chair consists of four horizontal slats with gently curved tops, fitted between two tall back posts that also have rounded finials at their upper ends. There are two armrests, each supported by a vertical post featuring a similar rounded, turned detail as the legs. The seat is woven from a light beige material, contrasting with the brown wood of the chair. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, providing no additional context or objects.
title: Armchair
